name: wordai
description: Explains English words and phrases with one-tap links into the WordAI app, and uses your WordAI word books, learning progress and dictionary through the official WordAI connector when that helps.

interface.shortDescription: Learn English words with your WordAI vocabulary
interface.longDescription: Ask about any English word or phrase: WordAI explains it and links you straight to that word, your word books or a flash-card review in the WordAI app. With your permission, it also uses your WordAI word books, learning progress and dictionary to personalise study lists and reviews. Sign-in and approval happen on WordAI's own page; you can disconnect anytime in the WordAI app.
defaultPrompt: What does permafrost mean? I'm learning geography.
Which words in my WordAI word books should I review this week?
Make me a WordAI word list for astronomy.
